prompt.zh-TW: 風行腳踏車行的老闆想知道「這個月賺了多少」。他只看月底的資產負債表，能直接得到答案嗎？
prompt.en: The owner of Breeze Bicycles wants to know how much the shop earned this month. Can he get the answer straight from the month-end balance sheet alone?

text.zh-TW: 不能。資產負債表只看月底那一天，賺了多少要看損益表
text.en: No. The balance sheet shows only the last day of the month; how much was earned is on the income statement

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。一張是某一天的存量，一張是一段期間的流量。
feedback.en: Nice work. One is a stock on a given day, the other a flow over a period.

short.en: No, look at the income statement

text.zh-TW: 能。資產總計比上個月多出來的部分，就是這個月賺的
text.en: Yes. The amount by which total assets grew since last month is this month’s profit

feedback.zh-TW: 你想到比較兩個時點的差異，這個方向不錯。不過資產變多也可能是借款或股東出資造成的，和賺錢無關；要知道賺了多少，還是得看損益表。
feedback.en: Comparing two points in time is a good instinct. But assets can grow because of a loan or new capital, which has nothing to do with earning; to know the profit you still need the income statement.

short.en: Yes, from the rise in total assets

text.zh-TW: 能。現金比上個月多出來的部分，就是這個月賺的
text.en: Yes. The amount by which cash grew since last month is this month’s profit

feedback.zh-TW: 現金確實是大家最關心的數字，這點沒錯。不過賒銷賺到的錢還沒收到、借來的錢沒有賺到卻已經進帳，現金的增減和利益常常不一樣。
feedback.en: Cash is indeed the figure everyone cares about, that much is right. But profit on credit sales has not been collected yet, while borrowed money arrives without being earned; so the change in cash and the profit often differ.

short.en: Yes, from the rise in cash

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_sf72dfsv}}回答「某一天擁有多少」，{{term:tm_tkj8x3a7}}回答「一段期間賺了多少」，所以答案是{{option:o_nqe9}}。{{option:o_1829}}和{{option:o_8m3s}}都想用兩個時點的差額代替利益，卻忽略了借款、出資這些和賺錢無關的變動。
explanation.en: The {{term:tm_sf72dfsv}} answers what is held on a given day; the {{term:tm_tkj8x3a7}} answers how much was earned over a period, so the answer is {{option:o_nqe9}}. {{option:o_1829}} and {{option:o_8m3s}} both try to use the difference between two dates in place of profit, overlooking loans and capital that change the figures without any earning.
